nginx_user.description: User under which worker processes run.

nginx_group.description: Group under which worker processes run.

nginx_worker_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections per worker process.

nginx_event_method.description: Event notification method (e.g., epoll, kqueue, select).

nginx_sendfile.description: Use sendfile() for static file transfers.

nginx_tcp_nopush.description: Enable TCP_CORK (send headers + first chunk in one packet).

nginx_tcp_nodelay.description: Disable Nagle's algorithm (send small packets immediately).

nginx_keepalive_timeout.description: Time (seconds) to keep keep-alive connections open.

nginx_keepalive_requests.description: Maximum number of requests per keep-alive connection.

nginx_gzip_vary.description: Add 'Vary: Accept-Encoding' header for proxied requests.

nginx_gzip_proxied.description: Conditions under which to compress proxied responses (e.g., any, expired, no-cache).

nginx_gzip_types.description: MIME types to compress (only these will be gzip’d).

nginx_gzip_min_length.description: Minimum response size (bytes) to compress (smaller responses skipped).

nginx_client_max_body_size.description: Maximum allowed size of client request body (e.g., 1m, 100m).

nginx_hide_version.description: Hide Nginx version in error pages and response headers for security.

nginx_enable_stream.description: Enable stream module for TCP/UDP load balancing (e.g., for databases, DNS, etc.).

nginx_stream_error_log.description: Path to stream module error log (only used if enable_stream is true).

nginx_stream_listen_port.description: Port on which stream server listens (only used if enable_stream is true).

nginx_stream_upstream_name.description: Name of upstream to proxy to in stream block (only used if enable_stream is true).

nginx_upstreams.description: List of upstream groups for HTTP load balancing (defined in conf.d or sites-enabled, but included here for completeness).

max_fails.description: Fail attempts before marking server as unavailable.

fail_timeout.description: Time to wait before reattempting failed server (e.g., 30s).
